text: Appeal of Order to Comply (January 5, 2018) for 70 Spadina Road.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated January 5, 2018, regarding the property located at 70 Spadina Road, Folder No. 17 276757 PRS 00 IV, and doing so granted an extension of time to June 30, 2018.
